detailed_description:
The target video uses a cinematic 35mm film look with warm late-summer afternoon light, natural colors and soft film grain, set in 2012 Chongqing.
[Shot 1] A wide low-angle shot looks up <Subject 3>, the narrow old stone stairway with weathered brick walls, stilted old houses, tangled power cables overhead and a large banyan tree whose leaves throw moving shade on the worn steps. <Subject 1> (S1), the slim 18-year-old girl with long straight black hair, full see-through bangs and a small silver star-shaped hair clip above her right ear, a plain white short-sleeve T-shirt with a blue-and-white jacket tied around her waist, dark trousers and worn white canvas shoes, sits on her large red-white-blue striped woven plastic bag halfway up the steps, holding a folded slip of paper. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed. <Subject 2> (S2), the thin, tall 18-year-old boy with slightly messy black hair, an unzipped blue-and-white tracksuit-style school jacket over a gray T-shirt and a worn black backpack on one shoulder, walks down the steps along the wall side of the stairway, still about five steps above her, with a bored, irritated face, not looking at her.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the camera cuts to a medium close-up of <Subject 1> (S1) standing up from her bag on the lower steps, looking up at the boy who is still several steps above her, holding the folded paper out in front of her with a polite, hesitant expression and keeping her distance from him. <Subject 1> (S1) calls out in a clear, slightly nervous young female voice with a light Chongqing accent, <d>[Chinese] 请问，去学校往上走吗？</d>
[Shot 3] At 00:05.500, the camera cuts to a medium shot of <Subject 2> (S2) from the side, still walking down the steps without stopping and without turning his body toward her, about three meters away from her, glancing sideways at the paper and then jerking his chin up toward the top of the stairs. <Subject 2> (S2) answers in a low, lazy, slightly hoarse young male voice with a Chongqing accent, in a dry, mildly sarcastic tone, without breaking stride, <d>[Chinese] 上头。爬一半了还问。</d>


overall_soundscape:
Cicadas buzz steadily in the banyan tree. Canvas shoes scuff on stone steps, the plastic bag rustles, and a faint river-ship horn drifts up from far below.
